Actuation.description: The force law of a phase.

oneOf.description:
The range and tangent branches, or in a phase with `shrink_rate_mps` the
circle law: a continuous hold of the body's sphere radius (the default).

Brake every pushed body to rest relative to the target and hold the plane;
`max_velocity_mps` is read as 0.

CapturePlanDevice.description: The capture device. Every field is optional; an absent field takes its default.

end_mass_kg.description:
Mass of the tail, and of the root unless `project.json` gives the chaser a
`mass_kg`, in kg. Default 2.0; greater than 0.

joint_damping_angular.description:
Angular damping of each tether joint. Default 1.0; not negative. No effect on
the rope model (point masses); kept for file compatibility.

joint_damping_linear.description: Linear damping of each tether joint. Default 1.0; not negative.

segment_mass_kg.description: Mass of each interior tether node in kg. Default 0.25; greater than 0.

segment_spacing_m.description:
Distance between tether joints in metres. Default 0.25; greater than 0, and the
tether may have at most 1,000 bodies (a warning above 200).

spawn_orientation.description:
How the tether is laid out at spawn, from both bodies' states at the start
epoch: `toward_target` (the tail trails along the root-to-target line, away
from the target), `v_bar` (behind the chaser along its velocity axis) or
`r_bar` (below it, toward the Earth). Default `toward_target`. A spawn
condition, not a held attitude.

tether_length_m.description: Physical length of the tether in metres. Default 20.0; greater than 0.

CaptureSphere.description: The capture sphere around the target.

initial_radius_m.description: Radius in metres at the start of every capture. Default 25.0; greater than 0.

min_radius_m.description: The radius the capture sphere stops shrinking at, m. Default 0.1.

ConditionBounds.description: Bounds on one quantity; at least one, neither negative. Both strict.

greater_than.description: Holds while the quantity is above this value.

less_than.description: Holds while the quantity is below this value.

MigratedFromV0.description:
The v0 content a migration could not map, so the file can be written back
without losing it.

unmapped.description: Every unmapped v0 value with its JSON Pointer into the v0 document.

Phase.description: One phase of the plan: the controller's limits while in it and its transitions.

actuation.description:
`circle`: the range and tangent branches, or in a phase with
`shrink_rate_mps` the circle law (the default); `hold`: brake every pushed
body to rest relative to the target and hold the plane; `max_velocity_mps`
is read as 0.

controller.description:
The controller's gains in this phase; every key optional, each
defaulting to the controller's built-in value. Absent: all defaults.

end.description: Marks an end phase (`success` or `abort`); an end phase has no transitions.

hold_plane.description:
Hold the pushed bodies in the circling plane through the target: a
proportional force component toward the plane, full at `PLANE_HOLD_BAND_M`
of height. Default false.

id.description: Phase id, unique in the plan and not blank.

max_force_n.description: Force applied to each tether node in N; not negative.

max_velocity_mps.description: Speed limit of the tether nodes in m/s; not negative.

shrink_rate_mps.description: Rate at which the capture sphere shrinks in m/s; not negative. Absent: no shrink.

tail_actuation.description: Push the tail in this phase as well as the root. Default false.

tail_spacing_m.description:
The chord from the root to the tail the controller holds, in m, the tail
behind the root in the sense of circling, in a phase that pushes the tail.
Without it the tail circles on its own sphere with no spacing held (the
pre-O5 law). Greater than 0 and less than `device.tether_length_m`.

transitions.description: Checked in order every step; the first whose conditions all hold fires.

velocity_scales_with_sphere.description:
The phase's speed limit is `max_velocity_mps` at the capture-sphere radius
the phase was entered at and falls in proportion as the sphere shrinks.
A no-op in a phase without `shrink_rate_mps` (the radius stays where it
was entered). Default false.

PhaseController.description:
A phase's controller gains. Every field is optional; an absent field takes
the controller's built-in default.

dead_band_fraction.description:
The relative width of the hysteresis band on the branch law's inner and
outer edges, and of the velocity kill band (at least two steps' Δv
(2 × `max_force_n` × step / mass)); 0 removes the hysteresis. Default
0.02; at least 0 and less than 0.5.

force_ramp_s.description:
Seconds the force bound takes to rise from 0 to `max_force_n` at the
capture start and at every phase entry. Default 1.0; greater than 0.

inner_edge_fraction.description:
The branch law's inner edge as a fraction of the sphere radius: inside it
the body is pushed away from the target. Default 0.8; greater than 0 and
less than 1.

plane_hold_band_m.description:
`hold_plane`: the height above or below the circling plane, in m, at which
the component toward the plane reaches full weight. Default 1.0; greater
than 0.

radial_rate_band_mps.description:
The circle law: the outward speed against the sphere's own shrink, in m/s,
at which the rate term reaches full weight. Default 0.1; greater than 0.

radius_hold_band_m.description:
The circle law: the radius error, in m, at which the radial term that holds
a body on its sphere reaches full weight; proportional below it. Default
2.0; greater than 0.

spacing_band_m.description:
The tail's lag law: the error in the root-to-tail chord, in m, at which the
tail's tangent weight saturates. Default 3.0; greater than 0.

spacing_rate_band_mps.description:
The tail's lag law: the difference in the ends' speeds along their forward
tangents, in m/s, at which the rate term saturates the tail's tangent
weight. Default 0.3; greater than 0.

PhaseEnd.description: How an end phase ends the capture.

SpawnOrientation.description: The axis the tether is laid along at spawn.

oneOf.description: The tail trails along the root-to-target line, away from the target.
The tail trails along the chaser's −V-bar (its LVLH along-track axis).
The tail hangs along the chaser's −R-bar (its LVLH radial axis).

all_of.description: The conditions; all must hold (AND). At least one.

to.description: Id of the phase to enter.

closing_rate_mps.description:
Rate at which the range between the tether root and the target is
shrinking, m/s; positive while closing. The same root and target as
`distance_m`; does not hold while the range is 0.

distance_m.description: Range between the tether root and the target in metres.

relative_speed_mps.description: Magnitude of the LVLH relative velocity in m/s.

tether_straightness.description:
How far the tether bows away from the straight line between its root and
its tail: the largest distance of any tether body from that line divided by
the root-to-tail distance; 0 = straight, dimensionless. `less_than: 0.15`
holds while no body is farther than 15 % of the root-to-tail distance from
that line. Does not hold while the root and the tail are within 1e-6 m.

time_in_phase_s.description: Seconds since the current phase was entered.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer into the v0 document, e.g. `/states/2/transitions/0/distance/units`.

value.description: The value as the v0 file had it.

description:
A capture plan file, schema v1. Lengths are metres, speeds m/s, forces N,
masses kg; there is no unit key.

capture_sphere.description: The capture sphere. Absent: every default applies.

device.description: The capture device. Absent: every device default applies.

migrated_from_v0.description: What a migrated v0 file held that v1 has no field for (written back unchanged).

name.description: Display name shown to the user. Not used as a lookup key. Must not be blank.

phases.description: The phases in order; a capture starts in the first. At least one.

schema_version.description: File format version; `1`. A file without it is a v0 plan and is migrated on load.

tether.description: Id the tether is registered under. Must not be blank.

title: CapturePlan
